notes: Chunk 100: 25 candidates reviewed from saved text; 12 program-list, 0 single-record, 13 not-a-list. Institutions kept as given by host. The four UNIL pages are two pages served from two CMS hosts (cin.cms.unil.ch and iltp.cms.unil.ch) with identical text; integrate once (canonical site is hec-phd on www.unil.ch). The Lausanne past-theses page is the richer source (2006-2021 graduates with thesis titles); the placements page gives only seven testimonial names with current positions. Mannheim GESS alumni.html mixes three doctoral centres (Business CDSB, Economics CDSE, Social Sciences CDSS); only the Business section is in scope, and all positions are current-at-capture (2019-02), not first jobs. The GESS job-market page is economics-only and marked not-a-list. USC Marshall placement page lists graduates across all areas 1994-2018 (two Operations names) as a sample, not a census. UMass ScholarWorks is a university-wide dissertation index (first page only, 2013-2014) with two Isenberg entries. St. Gallen GPEF (economics and finance) and DIA (international affairs) pages are named lists marked not-a-list because they fall outside management; the GPEF table has about 90 names with employers and positions 2009-2021 if the integrator decides finance counts. Wharton LGST and Padua pages list names only (no placements); UNSW student-placements lists 14 names across all business-school areas without years; Foster recent-placements has institutions only.
